presentation.description:
Alpha.

Submarine-focused fork of AutoRetainer. Manages unlocking, levelling and profit routes for your submersibles across characters, sells submarine salvage at the Limsa vendor (needs Lifestream and vnavmesh), runs Salvage Mode on the MultiMode loop, and sends gil from your alts to a host character that runs OrangeJuice Host.

Plugin from https://pfa.marobotic.dev/repo/
presentation.summary: Automatic submarine management, from the comfort of your bed.

variant.author: NightmareXIV, kawaii, Mayo Botic
variant.changelog: 1.1.0: a new look. A side rail on every page, and a main page that asks what we are doing today with task cards that start a run: run submarines, sell salvage, send gil, send retainers, levequests. Only one run goes at a time. A new Activity page follows the run live: the characters coming up, what the current one is doing and holds, and the gil and salvage made so far, with the log one click away. Statistics count the host's gil while it is connected. New icon.
